items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript
items.q: I've mastered 22 pieces in Big Chief. Uh, what's his name? Uh, the one that arranged for the brass. Wardell Casetta.

ctx.x: You'd like to go with the whole big thing like Ray Charles?

Well, I think he's a little too big, I don't think I, well I have mastered it. I've mastered 22 pieces in Big Chief. Uh, what's his name? Uh, the one that arranged for the brass. Wardell Casetta. Wardell Casetta. Wardell Casetta. And that was about the biggest thing I ever did, you know. And it was about 22 pieces and that, all that they did in overdub, you know. It was a live 22 pieces. And since then my mind's been big, you know. I just can't afford it, you know. I wish I could. Right. Yeah, because I can dream…

But you have to have a club, has to be able to support that many musicians. You don't have any clubs in New Orleans if you pay the price that you have to. I mean for recording sessions or something. You still have to pay them. You have to be in the union.

items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Well Wardell would give me a hand with it because he had to write the music for all the other instruments.

ctx.x: Let me tell you. In the end. I'm trying to think. After Rip you went with, you did some things for Joe Asanto again. Yeah. And that was about, you did Third House from the Corner. Yeah. And Big Chief. Yeah. And well the Big Chief was a big thing. Earl King said he wrote that. He wrote that. Yeah.

Earl King, I just helped him out with it. Did he come up with the arrangement or did you? Well I had to rearrange some of the things. To fit what I was putting into his song you know. I had to rearrange the beat. And I had to rearrange the breaks. Well Wardell would give me a hand with it because he had to write the music for all the other instruments. I never find nobody could write for me you know. And Wardell's good, he can write for anybody. Oh but me? I don't know.
He sounded pretty good on that. Well I don't have any piano music.
